title: Settings
newProgrammeMeta: Start again from your profile and equipment
aboutLocal: Your data stays on this phone. No account, no server.

newDialog.title: Start a new programme?
newDialog.text: We generate one from your current profile and equipment. You’ll see what changes before it replaces the one in progress.

profilePage.goalHint: Changing it needs a new programme.
profilePage.scheduleHint: Changing sessions a week needs a new programme.
profilePage.bodyweightNote: Used for starting loads in your next programme.
profilePage.outdated: Saving marks your current programme as out of date. You choose when to update it.
profilePage.needsNew: Changing the goal or sessions a week needs a new programme.
profilePage.saved: Profile saved. Your programme is out of date.
profilePage.newDialogGoal: With a new goal, sets, reps and rest change. You’ll see what changes before it replaces your current programme.
profilePage.newDialogDays: With {{days}} sessions a week the split changes. You’ll see what changes before it replaces your current programme.
profilePage.newDialogBoth: With a new goal and {{days}} sessions a week the programme changes. You’ll see what changes before it replaces your current programme.
profilePage.leaveText: Your profile changes will be lost.
